_meta.source: MOE, SEAB, ITE, SkillsFuture Singapore public pages
_meta.notes: The system runs on acronyms and students are expected to absorb them by osmosis. Kept a little longer than the rest of the copy budget on purpose: these entries carry the explanation load for the weakest readers, so cutting them hardest would cut the students who need them most.

terms.plain: Since 2024 there are no more Express, Normal Academic or Normal Technical classes. You take each subject at the level that fits you, G1, G2 or G3, and you can mix them.
The national exam that replaces the O and N Levels. One certificate listing each subject and the level you took it at. First sat in 2027.
Which group you went into at the end of primary school, from your PSLE score. It sets your starting levels. It does not lock them.
The three levels a subject can be taken at. G3 covers the most ground fastest, G1 is the most practical. They are levels of a subject, not levels of a person.

terms.full: One language plus four relevant subjects
terms.plain: The score used for JC and MI entry. Lower is better. It replaced L1R5.

terms.full: English, two relevant subjects, two better subjects
terms.plain: The score used for polytechnic entry. Lower is better.

terms.full: English, Maths and three best subjects
terms.plain: The score used for the Poly Foundation Year and some ITE entry. Worked out at G2 grades.
A one year foundation inside a polytechnic, taught by poly staff, leading straight into Year 1 of a diploma.

terms.full: Direct Entry Scheme to Polytechnic Programme
terms.plain: An old route into Higher Nitec with a guaranteed poly place. It ends with the 2028 ITE intake, so it will not be there for you.
You apply on your interest and aptitude for one course, and can get a place before your results come out. What you have done and can talk about is what counts.
The main posting after results. You rank your choices and are placed by score.
The main ITE qualification. Two years, practical, and employers know it straight away.
The level above Nitec. From here the polytechnic route opens, and from there the degree route.
How results are scored at ITE and poly. For ITE students applying to poly, 2.5 is the minimum and 3.5 or above guarantees a place.
NAFA and LASALLE sit under it. Entry leans on a portfolio or audition rather than a score.
A SkillsFuture route where you are employed and paid while working towards a qualification.
Covers up to 90 percent of course fees for adults, including full time diplomas at ITE, the polys, NAFA and LASALLE.
The part of school that helps you think about what comes next. Your school has an ECG counsellor. It is free and it is the most underused thing in the building.
